items.text: Bengals HC Zac Taylor said Ja’Marr Chase remains in concussion protocol; Tee Higgins now day-to-day with adductor injury.
items.why: Chase concussion early, Higgins adductor late in Week 4 loss.
items.implication: Chase likely miss Week 5 (protocol avg ~9 days); Higgins questionable; Burrow targets shift to others.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Bengals WRs/TEs if both limited.

items.text: Tyquan Thornton dislocated ankle (reset, out indefinitely, good spirits); Rashee Rice hamstring tweak, will use bye to recover; Chiefs previously interested in Tyreek Hill.
items.why: Thornton carted after big game; Rice left early, doubtful return.
items.implication: Thin WR room; potential Hill reunion; Worthy/others elevate.
items.opportunity: Targets open for remaining Chiefs pass-catchers.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) is among Sunday injuries being watched after exiting early; coach later said chances for Week 5 start unknown but not expected to be crazy long-term.
items.why: Left with ankle injury, boot postgame, MRI scheduled; coach comments optimistic on timeline.
items.implication: Potential Huntley start downgrades Ravens skill players if out; monitor practice.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and Tank Bigsby (undisclosed) among key injuries watched after Barkley exited early Week 4.
items.why: Hamstring injury on early carry; ruled out; walking normally postgame, not overly serious per reports.
items.implication: Risk miss London Week 5; Bigsby/Shipley elevate if out.

items.text: Broncos good MRI news on CB Pat Surtain II and WR Pat Bryant ankle injuries; avoided worst-case, both absences expected short-term.
items.why: MRI results positive vs initial sprain concerns.
items.implication: Quicker return possible than 'few weeks'; less long-term DEN WR impact.

items.text: Bills OC Joe Brady on Dalton Kincaid's 2 targets: 'I have to be better. There is no reason Dalton Kincaid should have two targets, especially with the flow of the game.' Target share data without DJ Moore showed Kincaid at 13%.
items.why: Coach self-critique after low involvement; Moore shoulder exit boosted others.
items.implication: Expect increased TE targets going forward, especially if Moore limited.
items.opportunity: Higher route/target share for Kincaid in two-TE or Moore-absent scripts.

items.text: Puka Nacua played 76-of-84 snaps in return, ran 49 routes on 64 dropbacks, 12 targets plus goal-line carry; prior hysteria unfounded, no workload limit per Schefter.
items.why: Full participation confirmed post-hip/groin; ETR had only small dock pregame.
items.implication: Immediate WR1 reinstatement ROS; high target share locked.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is this year's Javonte Williams: the boring mid-round RB no one wanted due to talent/role uncertainty who ends up starting and crushing.
items.why: Consistent production from uncertain mid-round profile.
items.implication: Strong ROS hold/start as RB2/flex with expanded role.

items.text: EXPECTED TO PLAY: Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears. GTD/OPTIMISTIC: Mike Evans. NOT EXPECTED: Jalen Coker, Terry McLaurin, Keenan Allen. STARTING: Tyson Bagent.
items.why: Weekend reports summary; Levitan notes small docks for Nacua/Flowers, bigger for McConkey/Evans.
items.implication: Nacua full, McConkey limited risk; McLaurin miss confirmed; Bagent start for CHI.
items.opportunity: Addison upside with Jefferson out; Bagent/CHI backs elevated.

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse: without three of most important players vs Rams - DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun.
items.why: Multiple key absences compounded by Barkley hamstring exit.
items.implication: Offense depleted; Hurts/remaining skill limited upside; backups elevate.

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson said QB Tyson Bagent expected to start Sunday at Green Bay.
items.implication: CHI skill (Odunze, Swift, etc.) face downgrade vs GB; monitor Monangai thumb.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love frustrated with snap management limiting ability to help team; coaches managing workload/ankle maintenance for freshness in long season, not injury; only 11 second-half snaps in close game.
items.why: Player quotes on management; accepts role for physical better options in key spots.
items.implication: Cap on volume/upside; committee risk persists.

items.text: Not one but two Bhayshul Tuten touchdowns have been called back due to penalty.
items.why: Near-scores indicate red-zone/opportunity role despite penalties.
items.implication: Positive underlying usage for JAC RB; stash/handcuff value.
